answer_1.quote: Neural text generation is one of the extensively studied tasks of natural language processing (NLP), as it forms the basis for dialogue systems, machine translation, and text summarization.

answer_2.quote: From seven total quantitative metrics we adopt to evaluate our model, Perplexity, KL-Divergence, and MS-Jaccard are closely related to the likelihood of generated texts. The other four metrics, namely Self-BLEU, Distinct-n, Repetition, and Uniq measure the text diversity.
